_comment: Generated islands (docs/islands.md). Every number is here; loaded once at startup. Metres = blocks. The mapped 104 ellipses are never touched; islands are extra rotated ellipses of the same footprint, per world seed.
_mode_note: on = mapped land plus the seeded islands; off = prompt 07 exactly (no island exists)
_salt_note: mixed into the world seed derived from the coast noise; change it to get a different island layout from the same world seed
_square_note: islands exist only inside the 50 km square (|x|, |z| <= half); an island whose outline plus edge_margin leaves the square is rejected, so islands simply stop at the edge and open sand continues
_raster_note: placement works on a 50 m grid of the NOISY mapped coast (rock/sand) and its exact distance transform; the gap and size tests use the exact ellipse distance
_gap_note: nominal (before the coast noise) outline-to-outline distance an island needs to every other land mass; the coast model's gap guard then keeps at least min_sand of sand after the noise

sizes._bins_note: semi-axis of the long axis (so 2 x this is the length across): log-uniform inside the bin, pushed towards the small end by skew (u^skew)

_visibility_note: an island whose estimated peak (the ramp at rim_fraction of its minor semi-axis) is below min_peak blocks above the sand is not placed. min_above_mountain: the estimated peak must also stand this many blocks above the dune mountain lift (mountain_height * clamp(offset + gain * noise)^2, the same noise and numbers as arrakis_mountain_mask, the lowest the dunes can be there) at the island centre and at 8 points of its outline. The ripple dunes (0 to 40 blocks) cannot be evaluated here; the burial that remains is measured on generated chunks
_ring_note: boundary cells of the noisy mainland coast become candidates with probability rate_per_km * gate(stretch noise); the island's outline is then pushed along the outward normal until its nearest distance to the mainland is the chosen gap in [gap_min + pad_inner, gap_max - pad_outer] (the pads leave room for the coast noise of both sides)
_archipelago_note: centres near the mainland coast (near_share) or further out; members come from an anisotropic Gaussian (long axis along the coast near land, random far from it); the first member is a larger core island
_scatter_note: a jittered lattice of 'cell' metre cells; a cell holds an island with probability density(distance from the mainland coast) * cell area; density is interpolated (log) between the knots
